expected.title: ETFBOOK raises USD 13M
expected.description: ETFBOOK develops data and analytics software for exchange-traded funds.

stories.title: ETFBOOK raises USD 13M
stories.description: ETFBOOK raised USD 13 million to expand its ETF data and analytics platform into the Americas and Asia-Pacific. Its APIs and web application combine fund holdings, flows and trading data; the company plans to broaden market coverage and add analytics tools.
stories.subject: Official ETFBOOK product visual showing the AuM & Flows dashboard and a monthly net-flows bar chart on a laptop.

evidence.visual: Decoded original visually inspected: ETFBOOK navigation, AuM & Flows heading and green monthly net-flow bars are visible. Original screenshot presented in the company's laptop mockup.
evidence.provenance: Exact img src/srcset on official homepage, alongside ETF data and analytics product sections.

stories.caveat: Official product screenshot/mockup, not a live market-data feed or a photo of the funding event. Preserve full UI image without cropping.

expected.title: Piomic Medical raises USD 25M growth financing
expected.description: Piomic Medical develops a wound-healing system that combines light and magnetic stimulation.

stories.title: Piomic Medical raises USD 25M growth financing
stories.description: Piomic secured USD 25 million in growth financing to complete clinical studies and prepare a US approval filing for COMS One, its portable system combining optical and magnetic stimulation for hard-to-heal wounds. The funding supports the MAVERICKS and NAZARÉ trials; the device remains investigational in the United States.
stories.subject: COMS One product-application image showing a hand connecting the therapy unit to its wound adapter.

evidence.visual: Decoded original visually inspected: a hand pressing the real device into the adapter tray. No investment text, logo-only composition or generic clinical stock scene.
evidence.provenance: Exact original asset referenced by the official product page in its COMS One Product Application section.

alternatives.subject: Official product-page header showing COMS One strapped to a leg.
alternatives.note: Visually verified but lower contrast and unusually wide; prefer application close-up.

evidence.rejected: 1254x1254 official financing composite inspected; device visible but USD 25M and financing text dominate.

stories.caveat: Official product demonstration, not evidence of clinical efficacy, regulatory approval or a patient outcome.

expected.title: NovaGo Therapeutics raises CHF 24M Series B
expected.description: NovaGo Therapeutics develops antibody treatments for spinal cord injuries and other central nervous system diseases.

stories.title: NovaGo Therapeutics raises CHF 24M Series B
stories.description: NovaGo Therapeutics raised CHF 24 million in a Series B to advance its antibody programme for acute spinal cord injury. The financing supports a randomised, double-blind proof-of-concept study enrolling 120 patients in Germany, Spain and Switzerland; the treatment targets Nogo-A, a protein that inhibits nerve regeneration.
stories.subject: Stefan Moese, NovaGo Therapeutics CEO, in the company's official profile portrait.

evidence.visual: Photographic head-and-shoulders portrait of CEO in glasses and a dark suit.
evidence.identity: Original About page HTML associates exact image with Stefan Moese PhD Chief Executive Officer; funding release independently names him as CEO.
evidence.date: Company-issued release dated September 2, 2026; CHF 24M and USD 30M are the same round.
evidence.retrieval: Web extraction failed for company page; CLI retrieval successfully returned actual company HTML and image. Not treated as access denial.

stories.caveat: Small CEO portrait withdrawn as a cover substitute; older story needs an appropriate product, research or team visual.
